newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 9.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 9.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 53.25 points to close at 6,609.16 for its third consecutive winning session, lifted by resurgent high-technology stocks.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index jumped 28.02 points to 1,162.25 to erase eight days of losses.

* Ringgit quoted at 2.5060/70 a dollar at around 0000 GMT after falling to three-month low of 2.51 on Tuesday, due to surge of the dollar/yen to four-year highs and unwinding of long ringgit positions reportedly by U.S. hedge funds.
* Public Bank said it was proposing the listing of its subsidiaries Public Consolidated Holdings and KL Mutual Fund.
* ABB Asea Brown Boveri, contracted to design and build the Bakun hydro-electric dam, said it was confident about the viability of the project.

* The Malaysian market was expected to continue riding higher in morning trade, an analyst said. "In the morning, it should continue to strengthen, but it will close off highs. I think a lot of people are ready to throw" their stocks in the afternoon, said a research manager at a Singapore house.
